description: This file defines the 'FieldExpression' interface used within the query expression package of the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares a method 'accept' for visitor-based evaluation, serving as a core component in the expression hierarchy.

classes.name: FieldExpression
classes.description: An interface representing a field-based query expression that supports visitor-based evaluation.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to evaluate this expression, returning a result of type T.
